Write a Python module with a single function detect(record: dict) -> bool. Return True if record['spend_1h'] > 10 * record['baseline_1h']. Output ONLY the Python code.

IMPORTANT: _is_alive(pid) must detect ZOMBIE/dead processes — use os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG) or /proc/<pid>/status, NOT just os.kill(pid,0). Output ONLY the Python code.
